data/pwc_publications.csv.gz.description: Archived analytic PwC records with frozen historical DOI enrichment; only identifiers, dates, tasks and methods retained. All 325,674 analytic input records and their original order retained.

data/pwc_snapshot_dates.csv.gz.description: arXiv-linked records from the complete archived PwC snapshot, used exclusively for Figure 1 and Table B1; the DOI-enriched analytic input is a separate source population. Non-arXiv records are irrelevant to both outputs and omitted here.

data/pwc_identifier_aliases.csv.gz.description: Only distinct historical arXiv–DOI aliases that add a key not already attached to the same arXiv publication in the primary input. Redundant aliases and aliases outside the analytic PwC record set are omitted.

data/lis_references.csv.gz.description: Final verified bibliographic reference metadata. Cited publication years use the adjudicated values. No age filtering, reference deduplication, PwC matching or task allocation is precomputed in this input.

data/topic_search.csv.gz.description: DOIs and years from the archived WoS topic-search export. Matching to the analytic pool, deduplication and annual shares are recomputed by the program.

data/task_hierarchy.csv.gz.description: Complete archived hierarchy paths, including repeated paths; column order is first level, second level, then descendant columns.

data/method_hierarchy.csv.gz.description: Complete archived hierarchy paths, including repeated paths; column order is first level, second level, then descendant columns.

data/arxiv_categories.csv.gz.description: Only archived records eligible for Table B1: identifier years 2010–2022 with at least one of the six selected categories. Full category-membership strings retained; no aggregate coverage counts supplied.

data/study_annotations.json.description: Journal classifications, curated literature table, Appendix A display selections and WoS retrieval expression. No obsolete model flag or quantitative outcome is an input.
